summary: V4 (Smart Reminders + Story Bank) — backend 6/6 pytest passing and frontend end-to-end verified via Playwright. Reminders derive correctly from seeded events (Marketing case submission=Tomorrow, Google APM=In 3 days), from company next_actions (Google, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip in applied/interviewing/networking stages), and from birthdays within 21 days; POST /api/reminders/dismiss idempotently hides an id and subsequent GET excludes it. Story Bank list returns 2 seeded stories ('Turning around the ISB Marketing Club', 'A decision I'd make differently') with full STAR + themes + status; CRUD works; POST /stories/{id}/polish returns refined STAR fields, a non-empty warm coaching 'feedback' sentence, and status='polished' (~4s Claude call). Frontend: Home renders 'A gentle nudge' section (home-reminders) with 4 reminder rows (correct icon per kind, correct relative detail), hover reveals the X, click removes the row immediately. /stories (linked from More via more-stories) shows editorial cards with theme chips + POLISHED status; story-open-{id} opens story-modal with editable story-title + STAR textareas; story-polish returns Kukdi's note into story-feedback; story-save persists; add-story-btn opens story-add-modal, story-add-save creates a story that appears in the list; story-delete-{id} works. Regression: Home greeting+brief still renders, all prior V3 tests remain healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/reminders.py _compute: reads events/people/companies collections on every GET /reminders call — fine for MVP scale but consider a light in-memory cache (TTL 30s) if the home page starts polling.

routes/reminders.py _days_until_birthday: parser only handles 'Month Day' formats (e.g. 'March 15'); it silently returns None for ISO dates like '1998-03-15'. Consider also parsing YYYY-MM-DD so future person imports don't accidentally lose birthday nudges.

routes/stories.py polish_story: no try/except around the LLM call — if Claude returns invalid JSON or errors, the endpoint 500s and the UI's polishing spinner never resolves. Wrap and return a graceful 502 or fall back to the original story with a friendly feedback message.
routes/stories.py update_story: does not restrict which fields can be updated via StoryUpdate — verify the Pydantic model excludes id/created to prevent client-side field overrides.
Home.jsx dismissReminder: optimistic UI update is good, but if the POST fails the row is gone forever until reload — add a rollback on error.
seed_data_creation: Test creates a throwaway TEST_BdayPerson (birthday +5 days) to safely verify dismiss without polluting seed dismissals; deleted after test. TEST_ stories/UI stories cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V4 features fully verified. Run V4 suite: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_v4_reminders_stories.py -v`. Polish endpoint takes ~3-6s (Claude). Reminders use deterministic ids (event:/birthday:/action:) so dismissal is idempotent — but dismissals persist in the singleton settings doc; prefer throwaway entities for dismiss testing.
